data.narrative:
Strand Therapeutics is a Series B–stage biotech company that has raised $205M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, with particular relevance from same–stage or adjacent–stage companies including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B Series C).

Two methods triangulate to a defensible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $205M total raised as a proxy base valuation, implying $390M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B reflecting material variance in capital efficiency and technology risk among cohort peers. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (8.1x median across tickers) cannot be applied without Strand's revenue figures, which remain confidential at the private stage.

The triangulated range is $331M (low), $2.1B (median), and $4.4B (high). The wide spread reflects uncertainty around Strand's clinical progress, commercial readiness, and whether the company tracks closer to the lower-valuation or higher-valuation peers. Stage-progression offers a more conservative floor; peer medians suggest material upside contingent on platform validation and execution risk.
